description: This Java class 'ContentResources' provides utility methods for converting FileData objects into HTTP responses, primarily for file upload/download functionalities in a REST API. It handles response creation for file content streams, including setting headers for content disposition, length, and type.

classes.name: ContentResources
classes.description: Utility class for handling file content responses, such as converting FileData objects into HTTP responses with appropriate headers.

methods.name: fileDataToResponse
methods.description: Converts FileData into a Response object with specified disposition type and filename, handling InputStream creation and error logging.
